name: wrist and hand overview
title: A wrist or hand complaint splits first on a fall or a numb hand: after a fall on an outstretched hand, a distal radius fracture is judged on X-ray as crooked, short or not smooth and reduced closed, or surgically if that fails, and a scaphoid fracture is treated as fractured even with a normal X-ray, cast if undisplaced or distal and operated if displaced or proximal; numbness splits by which fingers into carpal tunnel syndrome (median) and ulnar neuropathy at the wrist in Guyon's canal, each worked up against its nerve-root mimic with EMG and nerve conduction studies and treated in order from education to surgical release
